description: [roadmap S2.3] Surface_createFull (gfx_surface.cpp) erases the key's backend entries and creates nothing: the w x h surface the display's slot +0x7c makes for an Image is not modelled, so a body that reads it before a loadImage replaces it reports `no image` (showCreditsScreen and mainLoop's screen save only load into it or blit the root into it; the root-to-Image blit stays unsupported in Surface_blit3)
needed: a 16-bit Image store in the backend (Surface_blit3 with an Image destination) when a gated frame needs mainLoop's saved screen

description: [roadmap S2.3] Surface_drawRegion models jgld Sprite::draw -> draw16_1001cde0 at scale 1 only (the body branch g_10122dc0 / dc4 / dc8 select); the display's scale triple is assumed (1, 1, 1) as Image_draw's body assumes, and no gated frame draws the logo (the only drawRegion of the credits), so the frames do not check it
needed: a cov_r_quit checkpoint near the end of the scroll (the `$bink` line on screen)

description: [roadmap S2.3] drawText (gfx_prim_text.cpp) draws with the target's state-0 colour words as Widget_setQuad last stored them through this family; drawTextRun picks the state +0x30's colours when +0x40 is set and the backend tracks neither, and the core bodies drawCenteredText / drawText4049d0 (gfx.cpp) do not record the setQuad the original's drawCenteredText makes on the root, so a drawText after them without its own setQuad reads a stale or missing quad (reported when missing)
needed: the root surface's +0x30 / +0x40 writers modelled, and the core text bodies storing their setQuad through the family state

description: [roadmap S2.3] On the five credits frames the surface family's controls (1-8), prim_text 3 and credits 1 / 3 are equivalent mutants: the frames never free and redraw an object, the background crop has no trim, the logo line is never on screen, credits lines reach draw_text_run without the drawText body's limit, and CREDITS.txt has no line with leading spaces; each is RED in a unit test of test_gfx_credits.py instead. The logo (bink64.pcx) holds 29 bytes 0xfe and no 0xff, so its crop keeps the full 64 x 64 and Sprite::draw draws the 0xfe bytes that Image_draw's draw16 would skip
needed: a gated frame with the logo line

description: [roadmap S2.3] Surface_drawRegion / Image_draw on a Surface the backend holds no sprite for report unsupported, also when the original holds none either (a failed crop or load leaves the handle NULL and the original draws nothing, returning 7): the backend cannot tell a failed load from an object it never modelled
needed: a per-key record of the original's failed crops / loads in the backend

description: [roadmap S2.3] TraceInput::clock now advances the gfx snapshots past a served clock read (ordinal + 1: a checkpoint taken inside the read itself shows the frame before the work after it). Measured: in the 609-row census only the five credits rows changed (all to PASS); other ported loops that read the clock (showHoleStatsScreen's page animation, the PACE waits) hold no gated checkpoint, so the rule is not checked there
needed: a gated checkpoint inside showHoleStatsScreen or a PACE wait

description: [roadmap S2.3] showCreditsScreen.lines (gfx_credits.cpp) re-reads the credits section with the same rule as the port's credits_line_count (commands_screens.inc) because body arguments are 32-bit slots and the port keeps no line text in the address space; a different count is reported, a different text with the same count is not detected
needed: one shared reader of the section for the screen function and the backend (a header the commands module and the family both include)
